report_markdown:
## Bottom line
Dana Okafor runs network operations across 14 cross-dock facilities at Northwind Freight, since March 2023 [S1]. She came from Cobalt Parcel, last as Director of Linehaul [S1]. Northwind's 2026 operations update says her team is evaluating freight-audit and payment tooling this year [S2]. Who signs off on a vendor is not public: ask early.

## Profile
| Years | Organization | Role |
|---|---|---|
| 2023 to now | Northwind Freight | VP of Operations [S1] |
| about 2017 to 2023 | Cobalt Parcel | Director of Linehaul [S1] |

## Public work and statements
- 2026-02, talk, "Carrier scorecards that carriers will accept": scorecards change behavior when carriers see the same data and the same dispute window [S3].

## Organization and recent news
Cross-dock network of 14 facilities [S1]. 2026-01-20: the operations update names freight-audit tooling as an evaluation this year (published 2026-01-22) [S2].

## Likely priorities (inference)
- Cutting carrier invoice disputes, from her talk and the operations update [S2][S3].

## Talking points
1. Share how audit tooling changed dispute rates at a comparable shipper, with a number you can source [S3].
2. Ask what the 2026 evaluation has covered so far [S2].

## Questions
1. Which carriers or lanes drive the audit work, and what does a good outcome look like?
2. Who else is part of the vendor decision besides operations?
3. How did you handle freight audit at Cobalt Parcel?
4. What would make you drop a vendor?
5. What timeline is the evaluation working to?

## Gaps and coverage
Sign-off authority is not stated anywhere read. The Cobalt Parcel years and start date rest on the leadership page alone.
